answer: Lotus equivocation bond: each identity plants one lotus, a stake blooming in eight epochs, and locks 50 credits. Each epoch it emits one signed signal. If one identity signs two conflicting claims, the pair passes through the prism, which refracts the contradiction into public view; the lotus burns, the 50 bond slashed. A lotus costs 30 to grow, so 1,000 fakes pay 30,000 and lock 50,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 30 once, keep one lotus.
